Nasi Kerabu Ayam Percik.note: Serunding ikan (fish floss) and sambal budu (fermented anchovy) = fish; salted egg = egg. Kerisik is coconut, not a nut. Bean sprouts are mung bean. Mildly spicy = 1.

Nasi Kerabu Ulam.note: Sounds vegetarian ('no meat') but fish floss and budu = fish, so not vegetarian. Salted egg = egg. Mildly spicy = 1.

Nasi Dagang Ikan Tongkol.note: Tongkol (tuna) curry = fish; hard-boiled egg. Glutinous rice has no gluten. Fenugreek is not listed as an allergen. Spicy = 2.

Nasi Dagang Ayam.note: Chicken curry with coconut milk and kerisik (coconut); hard-boiled egg. No fish. Mild = 1.

Nasi Tumpang.note: Omelette = egg; sambal udang = prawns (crustaceans). Beef floss and chicken curry. Spicy = 2.

Laksam.note: Mackerel gravy = fish. Rice-flour noodles, no gluten. Coconut milk is not milk. Mildly spicy = 1.

Laksa Kelantan.note: Mackerel gravy and budu = fish. Rice noodles, no gluten. Mildly spicy = 1.

Mee Goreng Kelantan.note: Wheat noodles and kicap manis = gluten; kicap = soy; prawns = crustaceans; squid = molluscs; egg. Spicy = 2.

Bihun Goreng Sayur.note: Tofu and soy sauce = soy; soy sauce = gluten; egg, so vegetarian but not vegan. A little chilli = 1.

Ayam Percik.note: Coconut milk gravy, no listed allergen. Mildly spicy = 1.

Gulai Ikan Tongkol.note: Tuna = fish. Kerisik is coconut. Spicy = 2.

Solok Lada.note: Stuffed chillies sound vegetarian, but the filling is mackerel fish paste = fish. Mildly spicy = 1.

Ikan Kembung Bakar.note: Mackerel = fish; belacan in the air asam = crustaceans. Spicy = 2.

Sotong Celup Tepung.note: Squid = molluscs; wheat flour batter = gluten. Sweet chilli sauce = mild 1 (as thai-kitchen Tod Mun Pla).

Kerabu Pucuk Paku.note: Sounds like a vegetable salad, but dried shrimp = crustaceans, so not vegetarian. Very spicy = 3 (the only 3 on the menu).

Sayur Lemak Labu.note: Stated without dried shrimp; coconut milk is not milk. Vegan. Not spicy = 0.

Telur Dadar.note: Egg. Green chilli with no heat word = 1.

Budu.note: Budu is fermented anchovy = fish. Spicy = 2.

Keropok Lekor.note: Ikan parang = fish; wheat flour = gluten (hidden: often assumed sago only). Sweet chilli sauce = 1.

Cucur Udang.note: Prawns = crustaceans; wheat flour = gluten; egg. Chilli sauce = 1.

Satar.note: Fish paste = fish. No flour stated. Spicy = 2.

Pulut Panggang.note: Sounds like a sweet kuih, but filled with dried shrimp = crustaceans, not vegetarian. Glutinous rice has no gluten. A little chilli = 1.

Akok.note: Egg; wheat flour = gluten. Coconut milk is not milk.

Tepung Pelita.note: Rice flour and coconut cream. No listed allergen.

Ais Kacang.note: Roasted peanuts; evaporated milk. Red beans are not peanuts or soy.

Kopi O.note: Hidden allergen: kampung beans roasted with butter = milk, so vegetarian but not vegan, although no milk is added.

Kopi Susu.note: Butter roast and condensed milk = milk.

Air Kelapa Muda.note: Coconut is not a tree nut.
